description: Source code for handling TensorFlow operation attributes in Go, including functions to retrieve various attribute types from TensorFlow operations, such as strings, integers, floats, booleans, data types, tensors, and shapes.

classes.name: Operation
classes.description: Represents a TensorFlow operation, providing methods to access its attributes.

classes.description: Represents the shape of a tensor or operation attribute.

methods.name: scalarAttribute
methods.description: Handles retrieval of scalar attributes of various types from a TensorFlow operation.
